subject: Social Media
title: The Refresh Pull
description: Learn The Refresh Pull in one minute.

hook.text: You pull down on your feed to refresh it. That gesture was borrowed from slot machines. Literally.

buildup.text: Loren Brichter invented pull-to-refresh in 2010. He later expressed regret about its addictive design.

discovery.text: The brief loading moment creates a micro-suspense. What's new? The anticipation fires dopamine before content loads.

twist.text: Some platforms auto-refresh now, removing even the pull. You never have to decide to check—it just updates.

climax.text: Each design choice reduces friction. Less friction means less conscious choice. Less choice means more scrolling.

punchline.text: They removed every reason to stop.

quiz.question: What feature was pull-to-refresh borrowed from?
